journal_lines_tax_role_check.name: journal_lines_tax_role_check
journal_lines_tax_role_check.value: "ledger"."journal_lines"."tax_role" is null or "ledger"."journal_lines"."tax_code" is not null

ledger_accounts_owner_check.name: ledger_accounts_owner_check
ledger_accounts_owner_check.value:
(coalesce("ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_type", '') = 'bank_account') = ("ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_bank_account_id" is not null)
        and (coalesce("ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_type", '') = 'contact') = ("ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_contact_id" is not null)
        and (coalesce("ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_type", '') = 'platform') = ("ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_platform" is not null)
        and (coalesce("ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_type", '') = 'person') = ("ledger"."ledger_accounts"."owner_person_name" is not null)

ledger_booking_rules_target_check.name: ledger_booking_rules_target_check
ledger_booking_rules_target_check.value: "ledger"."ledger_booking_rules"."contact_id" is not null or "ledger"."ledger_booking_rules"."counterparty_pattern" is not null
